    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:50.199
    | text      = We have fixed your mic, and now we shall carry onward.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:56.800
    | text      = So here's the situation for those who have not heard.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:00.920
    | text      = On Saturday, July 13th, someone shot at Trump while he was speaking at one of his rallies
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:05.959
    | text      = in Butler, Pennsylvania.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:07.720
    | text      = As of the time of recording this episode, the shooter's name has been made public, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:11.560
    | text      = despite a great deal of effort being expended on all sides, it's really still not clear
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:16.160
    | text      = why he did what he did exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:19.040
    | text      = As details come out, we might get a better picture of the motive, but as of now, pretty
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:22.879
    | text      = much everyone who has this all figured out is full of shit and trying to lead you down
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:27.839
    | text      = a particular road.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:29.079
    | text      = Totally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:30.079
    | text      = It's a shocking image, obviously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:32.040
    | text      = A former president was shot at a campaign rally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:35.800
    | text      = You really don't think that this kind of thing can happen, or at least we try to tell ourselves
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:39.480
    | text      = that it doesn't happen here anymore, but clearly it does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:43.920
    | text      = And it did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:44.920
    | text      = I mean, the 80s were only 40 years ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:47.160
    | text      = But that's 40 years!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.720
    | text      = That's a long time!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:49.720
    | text      = I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:50.720
    | text      = I get it, I get it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:51.720
    | text      = It's a short time, but a long time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:52.720
    | text      = Oh, I get it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:53.720
    | text      = Short time, long time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:54.720
    | text      = I get it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:55.720
    | text      = I'm generally opposed to assassinations, particularly ones that take place in public like this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:01.000
    | text      = where civilians are wounded or killed, or there's a great danger on that front.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:06.120
    | text      = Even if you believe that Trump is an existential danger to many people should he be re-elected,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:10.759
    | text      = which I would agree with, this action doesn't really solve that problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:16.639
    | text      = So I'm not thrilled with this turn of events, let's say.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:21.319
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.319
    | text      = It's a very serious moment in time and a sign of how unacceptably far we are down this road,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:27.600
    | text      = but I also think that you have the right to process this kind of an event however you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.639
    | text      = need to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:32.639
    | text      = If your response is grim humor, I guess that's okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.759
    | text      = If it's reflecting on the rallygoer who died and the severity of the situation, that's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.040
    | text      = fine too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:41.319
    | text      = I was particularly bummed out, though, with how pretty popular it was for people to suggest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:45.800
    | text      = that Trump had staged this whole thing for optics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:49.139
    | text      = This really is just the same behavior that Alex engages in, where you take an outcome
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:53.160
    | text      = and write your own explanation for how it came about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:56.199
    | text      = I get that that picture of Trump with blood on his face with the flag behind him is an
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:00.800
    | text      = amazing piece of political propaganda, and Trump's people will make the most out of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:05.699
    | text      = He would want to create an image like that, but that doesn't mean that he did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:11.079
    | text      = The leap of taking something that's possible and deciding it's what must have happened
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:15.500
    | text      = is the same shortcut Alex takes, and it's what a lot of his most noxious conspiracies
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:20.079
    | text      = are based on, and I would advise people to avoid that kind of mental trap.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.199
    | text      = It's not productive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:26.600
    | text      = At the time of this shooting, Alex was not in studio.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:30.360
    | text      = In fact, he was not even in Texas.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.480
    | text      = He was on a secret mission, which is code for a vacation in Northern California, so
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.920
    | text      = he wasn't available to immediately pop on air and start yelling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.560
    | text      = Of course not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:43.000
    | text      = Apparently Owen was out of town, too, so it's just left to Chase and Harrison Smith to captain
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:47.639
    | text      = the ship, which gives everything a bit of a less important feel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.620
    | text      = It's a real downer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.000
    | text      = It sucks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:55.319
    | text      = It's a disaster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:56.319
    | text      = This is the junior varsity squad covering what is, in theory, the most important day
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:01.139
    | text      = that they have ever had on air since January 6th, and you've got fucking Brendan and the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.959
    | text      = baby Nazi just sitting there fucking... No juice, no energy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It sucks for about an hour until Alex shows up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
